verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is community-reported: users say Brave's free-tier Terms of Use prohibit using responses for AI inference, and that a separate AI Inference plan permits that use. This implies a documented permitted-use policy tied to plan tier, but nothing covers robots.txt or content licensing. Missing for 10: any evidence of a robots.txt or crawler policy, any content-licensing or rights stance, first-party documentation of permitted use (currently only secondhand from HN), and clear guidance reconciling AI-integration guides with ToS restrictions.
